references.text: The introduction to the inheritances that were distributed by Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun, which is completed in 19:51
The Israelite community gathered at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there, the same place mentioned at the conclusion of the land distribution
Joshua cast lots for them before the Lord at Shiloh and distributed the land, corresponding to the method described in 19:51
Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun were appointed to distribute the land as an inheritance, which is completed here
The Lord commanded that the land be distributed by casting lots, the same method used and completed at Shiloh
The entrance to the tent of meeting before the Lord, the same holy place where the lot was cast
The lot is cast into the lap, but the decision comes from the Lord - the principle behind the casting of lots in the land distribution
